ONE high-fidelity ARTEX desktop UI comparison image 'C · Conversation First', 1920x1200 landscape full desktop window in front view, sharply readable Korean UI type. Make C visually DIFFERENT from variants of a four-panel utility layout: main chat occupies most of width, RIGHT inspector is COLLAPSED and only a small '상세' toggle exists near title. Preserve a compact 190px left navigation rail with icon+Korean label for 작업 공간, 대시보드, 작업, selected 대화, 자산, 발견 사항, 객체 그래프, 작업 파일, 에이전트 실행, 실행 승인, 환경 설정. A slim 220px conversation list remains; no large right details panel. Shared fixture content: workspace 'ARTEX · Demo', compact header badge 'Bypass 켜짐', conversation '서비스 점검', user message '점검 결과를 정리해 주세요.', assistant '파일 확인이 완료되었습니다. 결과를 정리하고 있습니다.', inline collapsed tool 'Read · 완료', timestamp '10:32', composer '메시지를 입력하세요', attachment icon, blue '보내기'. Assistant text flows directly on canvas with no card outline. Compact inline tool action row blending into chat background; gently tinted pill only for status. Full canvas all edges, heading 'C · Conversation First' above window. Strictly Korean or English fixture only. This is conceptual custom styling not a framework screenshot, not an actual runtime. Balance readability with professional utility identity.

recommendation_ko: A의 공통 디자인을 기본으로 대화는 C의 넓은 영역, 실행 관리는 B의 탭·상태 구성을 적용한다. 세 디자인을 egui 전용 컴포넌트로 우선 검증한다.
